description: This PHP class defines the ProjectActivityReport, a part of the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends ProjectReport and handles generating a report related to project activities, including preparing filter parameters, defining validation rules, specifying report headers, and retrieving report data.

classes.name: ProjectActivityReport
classes.description: A report class for generating project activity reports within the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends ProjectReport, supports filtering, validation, header definition, and data retrieval related to project activities.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares filter parameters for the report based on request input, including project ID, activity ID, date range, and inclusion of timesheet approval data.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for request parameters, particularly validating that activity ID is positive and exists.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the headers (columns) for the report, such as Employee Name and Time (Hours), with localization support.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on provided filter parameters by creating a new ProjectActivityDetailedReportData instance.
